codeReview.summary: Fail. Commit `2d3ddf4` restores the inline LogsViewer error banner and removes the duplicate template save/delete toasts, but the VNC visibility fix does not actually follow the keep-alive visibility model. `useRouteActive('/vnc')` uses a prefix match, so the hidden cached `/vnc` page still counts as visible on `/vnc/session/...` routes and can keep polling while hidden.

issues.description: `useRouteActive()` returns `pathname.startsWith(routePrefix)`, but `ProtectedLayoutShell` hides cached keep-alive pages with exact-path matching (`pathname === routePath`). The app has distinct `/vnc` and `/vnc/session/:workflowId/:profileName` routes (`frontend/src/routes.ts:17-18`), and `useVncSessions()` is used on the session page too (`frontend/src/features/vnc/containers/VncSessionPageContainer.tsx:30`). When the user navigates to a session route, the cached `/vnc` page is hidden by `ProtectedLayoutShell.tsx:61-69`, yet `useRouteActive('/vnc')` still returns true there, so the hidden page can keep polling and recreate the cross-route keep-alive toast problem the fix was meant to eliminate.
